summary: iOS thread sharing implemented, not compiled. NEW FILES (FellowScript/FellowScript/Chat/, auto-included by the synchronized Xcode groups): ChatThreadView+Share.swift (enum ChatShareDelivery: canDeliver + deliver; a main-chat share sends immediately as before; a thread share requires threads + chat_shared_objects on, opens the thread via vm.openThread, waits for its first page, and sends once through the existing thread sendMessage path so local echo, ack, failed bubble and retry (pendingSharedByMessageId) are reused; if the thread cannot open or its first page fails, nothing is sent or fabricated, the thread view's own retry stays and cached messages are untouched) and ShareToChatSheet+Threads.swift (ShareThreadsViewModel + ShareGroupThreadsRows: a collapsed 'Threads' disclosure under each group in the picker, lazy-loads via the existing fetchThreads(limit 10), sorted by lastActivityAt desc and capped at 10 via the pure static ShareThreadsViewModel.recent, inline Retry on failure keeping any rows shown, 44pt targets, a11y labels). THIN EDITS: SharedObjectViews.swift (+9: PendingChatShare gets optional `thread: FSThreadSummary?`, picker shows the thread rows only when threads and chat_shared_objects are both on, send(to:thread:) ); ChatThreadView.swift consumePendingChatShare now delegates to ChatShareDelivery (file shrank 3966 -> 3963). Rendering and note open needed no change: thread history/live frames already decode attachment_kind/meta (FSThread.swift) and the bubble path uses SharedObjectContentView, whose note open calls GET /shared-objects/{user}/note/{message_id} with the (acked) thread message id, which the backend step 2 grant now accepts. Old clients are unaffected (fallback text). KNOWN LIMIT: a share whose target thread first page fails to load is dropped rather than re-queued (re-queuing would loop); user sees the thread's retry control and can re-share. Q1-Q6 defaults applied. COMPILE CHECK: NOT run, pgrep xcodebuild showed a running xcodebuild (pid 6603) and I do not run simulators; testing step 7 must compile and test serially. No tests written (testing gate owns them; suggested Swift tests: ShareThreadsViewModel.recent ordering/cap, PendingChatShare equality with thread, ChatShareDelivery.canDeliver). Docs not touched (step 8). Did not touch frontend/ or desktop/. Nothing pushed or deployed.
